verdict.rationale: vLLM documents a drop-in OpenAI-compatible API server plus Anthropic Messages API support, with tool calling (`auto`/`required`/named `tool_choice`), streaming, reasoning parsers and structured outputs. These are the core backend capabilities a coding agent needs, and a community user notes the OpenAI-compatible API lets them use ChatGPT applications against it. missing for 10: explicit first-party docs or guides for connecting named coding agents, hands-on or independent corroboration of a coding agent running reliably against vLLM.
